text:
The context menu in iOS 18 is a total UX paradigm shift. 🍎

Gone are the days of just copying and pasting. Now, whenever you select text, you have an instant AI assistant at your fingertips to rewrite, proofread, or summarize. It’s seamless, contextual, and incredibly powerful.

For mobile developers, this changes everything. It’s no longer just about building the input field; it’s about designing for *intelligence*. Users now expect their text interactions to be proactive, not passive.

This feature forces us to rethink how we handle text selection and content generation in our apps. It’s a massive signal that the "app" is becoming the "agent."

Are you integrating AI tools into your UI, or sticking to traditional inputs? Let’s discuss in the comments. 👇
bg_prompt: iOS 18 introduces a new context menu that transforms text selection into an AI-powered assistant for rewriting and summarization.
